Moments and the Gallery

Version 7 · Last updated 27 November 2026

A Moment is one day’s photos. The Gallery shows them one Moment at a time, so naming and sorting stay small.

Choosing a Moment

Tap the calendar at the top left to see your Moments, newest first, and pick one. The ‹ and › arrows beside the date move to the earlier and the later Moment. Tap All Moments to see the whole library at once (a big library takes a few seconds; the card says so); picking a Moment turns it off again. When you leave the Gallery for another surface and come back, it is where you left it, filter and all.

The Moment header

Beside the date are two small icons. The tag opens Tag the Moment, where you say who is in the photos, what the event was and where it happened. The face opens Name the Faces, which shows every face Livo found in the Moment so you can name them. See Tag the Moment and Naming the faces. The Moment’s menu also offers Make a Memory of these.

Marked photos

Swipe a photo to the right to mark it (a thumbs up); swipe it right again to take the mark off. The N Marked pill shows how many marked photos the library has; tap it to see only them. Marked photos are the set a new Memory is made from; see Making a Memory.

Selecting photos

Tap a photo to select it; keep dragging to select more. A row appears under the header: Select All, Clear, + Event (put the selection in an event), Make a Memory and Share. The bar at the bottom offers Tag (people, places and tags on all of them at once), Info (one photo), Delete (which asks first and moves the photos to the Trash), and … for the rest: Rotate, Set Date, Stitch for videos, Find Moment, and the Curator Tools with Livo Plus.

Opening a photo

Tap a selected photo, or double-tap any photo, to see it full screen. Swipe left or right to move between photos. Pinch to zoom, or double-tap to fill the screen and double-tap again to see the whole photo; drag to move around a zoomed photo. Swipe up to open the photo’s Details, and swipe down to close. A LIVE pill plays a Live Photo. The buttons under a photo include Info, Rotate, Edit Photo and, on a video, Edit Segments (Livo Plus); see Editing photos and videos. The tag icon at the top opens the Details strip for that one photo. If the full-size picture cannot be shown, the caption under it says why; see When something looks wrong.

Touch shortcuts

In the Gallery:

  • Pinch to change the size of the photos. Spread two fingers apart for fewer, larger photos; pinch them together for more, smaller ones. On an iPhone the steps are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 7 photos across. Livo keeps the size you chose.
  • Tap a photo to select it. Double-tap to open it full screen.
  • Swipe a photo to the right to mark it (a thumbs up). The same swipe takes the mark off.
  • Swipe a photo to the left to give it a thumbs down; the same swipe takes it off.
  • Press and hold a photo to make it a favorite; press and hold again to undo. Searching for favorites finds them.
  • Slide to select. Once one photo is selected, slide your finger across the photos to select every photo from where you started to where your finger is. Sliding back shortens the run. A slide that starts on a selected photo takes its run out of the selection. While you are selecting, the left and right swipes do not mark.

With a photo open full screen:

  • Swipe left or right for the next or the previous photo.
  • Pinch to zoom, and drag to move around a zoomed photo. A video does not zoom.
  • Double-tap to fill the screen; double-tap again for the whole photo.
  • Swipe up to open the photo’s Details. Swipe down to close.
  • Press and hold to make it a favorite.

The badges on a photo

A small mark in the corner tells you what a photo is: video, LIVE, stitched, used in a Memory, or Aa when Livo has read text on it. Livo Plus adds marks for a scanned print and a photo in a Bucket.
